decision: Do not consume a fifth fixed100 from the Beat-The-Bookie holdout or any other untouched confirmation sample for another transformation of already-tested 1X2 trajectory, team-history, score-history, Elo, venue, maturity, centrality, pairwise, or rich-stat residual families. A fifth fixed100 may be locked only after a genuinely new pre-match orthogonal information family is identified, its point-in-time provenance and coverage are audited with zero target-label access, and its representation/model is preregistered before identity locking.

findings: R39C three-snapshot trajectory produced only weak probability/ranking increments and no first100 Top1 Draw increment.
R39D absolute decision threshold increased Draw recall but exchanged correct H/A decisions one-for-one and did not increase total accuracy.
R39E fixed-bookmaker dense T-24h..T-1h sequence improved probability proper scores and Draw AUC versus R39C on third100 but did not improve Top1 accuracy or Draw F1.
R39F market-offset multinomial residual converged cleanly but fourth100 accuracy was 45% versus 46% market/R39C/R39E, with zero Top1 Draw calls.
